title: Checks for C-like enumerations that are repr(isize/usize) and have values that don’t fit into an i32.
summary: This will truncate the variant value on 32 bit architectures, but works fine on 64 bit. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.

title: Checks for use Enum::*.
summary: It is usually better style to use the prefixed name of an enumeration variant, rather than importing variants. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Detects enumeration variants that are prefixed or suffixed by the same characters.
summary: Enumeration variant names should specify their variant, not repeat the enumeration name. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.
